evidence.source: Read from the hosted ruleset itself on 25 August 2026, not from repository prose. GET /repos/nickygregal12-cmyk/Euro-2028-Predictor/rules/branches/main returned all three contexts under one required_status_checks rule sourced from repository ruleset 20508177, and GET /rulesets/20508177 agreed, reporting enforcement 'active', current_user_can_bypass 'never' and updated_at 2026-08-25T07:35:19.228Z. THE OVERNIGHT RUN IS WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: #1047 and a comment in mergeGateConfiguration.test.ts both asserted that 'vNext merged browser gate' was already a required context. It was not, and nothing in the repository could tell the difference, because a required-check set is hosted state that a clone cannot see. strict_required_status_checks_policy is false, so a branch need not be current with main before merging. UPDATED after #1048 merged at 347a2c9: four more workflows now publish an always-reporting context, so seven gates exist and three are required. The other four are listed as requirable rather than silently absent — a record of what could be required that omitted them would mislead in exactly the direction this file exists to prevent, and listing them means a later promotion reads as PROMOTED rather than as an unknown context appearing from nowhere.
